description: This PHP source file defines the SSOAdminClient class, which serves as a client for the AWS Single Sign-On Admin service. It includes method annotations for various API calls related to managing permissions, accounts, applications, policies, and other resources within the service.

classes.name: SSOAdminClient
classes.description: A client used to interact with the AWS Single Sign-On Admin service, providing methods to manage permission sets, accounts, applications, and related resources.

methods.name: attachCustomerManagedPolicyReferenceToPermissionSet
methods.description: Attaches a customer managed policy reference to a permission set.

methods.name: attachCustomerManagedPolicyReferenceToPermissionSetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously attaches a customer managed policy reference to a permission set.

methods.name: createAccountAssignment
methods.description: Creates an account assignment in the SSO service.
